meta.title: Iran Update Evening Special Report, March 2, 2026

key_takeaways: Iran is attempting to disrupt international shipping through the Strait of Hormuz as part of a broader effort to impose a cost on the Gulf states.

events.summary: QatarEnergy halted LNG production after drone attacks on Ras Laffan and Mesaieed.
events.evidence_quote: Qatar announced that it has ceased production of all liquefied natural gas (LNG) and associated products.
events.output_impact: Qatar ceased production of all LNG (~20% of global supply)

events.summary: Aramco shut Ras Tanura refinery as a precaution after attempted drone strikes.
events.evidence_quote: shut down its Ras Tanura refinery as a precautionary measure after Iranian drones attempted to strike the refinery on March 2.
events.output_impact: refinery shut down as a precautionary measure

events.summary: Projectiles reportedly hit a docked oil tanker in Bahrain, causing a fire.
events.evidence_quote: Iran also reportedly launched two unspecified projectiles at the Stena Imperative oil tanker, which was docked in Bahrain

chokepoints.evidence_quote: Iran is attempting to disrupt international shipping through the Strait of Hormuz
